name: vault-share-office-viewer
description: Browser bundle (static/office.js) that renders .docx/.pptx originals, based on Microsidian's viewer.

scripts.build: esbuild office.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=../static/office.js && esbuild editor.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=../static/editor.js && esbuild render.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=../static/render.js && esbuild mermaid-entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=../static/mermaid.js
